versions.changelog:
Version 1.0.0 introduces LinkedIn CTA optimization.

- Diagnoses weak or missing CTAs and offers 3–5 ranked alternatives tailored to one chosen goal.
- Uses Taplio analytics and niche inspiration to ground recommendations in real performance data.
- Can update an existing Taplio draft; scheduling requires timing, and publishing requires explicit confirmation.
- Requires the Taplio MCP and stops if it isn’t connected.
